tools.name: profile
tools.description: Work on the profiles of a session: list them, show what a profile holds with its context tokens (info), compact its transcript or reset it, show your own profile's configuration (config), change your own profile file, documents, own models and own toolsets (edit), list its changes (history) or restore an earlier version (revert).

path.description: What to act on. Omit it, or give self, for your own profile. profile:<category>/<name> (or profile:<session>/<category>/<name>) names another profile; session:<id> names a session, whose profiles action list shows. remote:<name>/profile:<session>/<category>/<name> asks a remote JAD server for info; only when allow_remote is on.

action.description: list: the profiles of the session. info: what the profile holds, with its context tokens. compact: compact the profile's transcript now. reset: delete the profile's transcript and history. config: your own profile only: its file, its revision, the settings it runs with and which layer set each, its private and data folders, its profile_self_edit level, what edit may change, and your own documents, own models and own toolsets with their revisions. edit: your own profile only: replace your profile file with contents, and/or create, replace or delete your own documents (documents, in {profile_own}/documents) and own models (models, in {profile_own}/models) and own toolsets (toolsets, in {profile_own}/tools), given the revision of your profile file config showed as if_match; one edit is one change, it must pass profile_self_edit and load, the old files are kept in your history, and it applies from your next run. history: your own profile's changes, newest first, with the documents, own models and own toolsets each touched. revert: restore what a history entry changed (history_id: the profile file, the documents, the own models and the own toolsets), with if_match, under the same rules as edit; refused if a document, own model or own toolset it touched changed since. compact and reset are refused to a sub-agent and to your own profile; config and history are refused to a sub-agent and to another profile; edit and revert are refused to a sub-agent, to another profile, in plan mode and in a run another profile, a sub-agent or a remote server started. reset is refused while a run of the profile is active; compact waits for a live run to end.

contents.description: The whole new profile file, as config shows it under contents with your changes. Only with action edit; leave it out to change only documents, own models or own toolsets.

path.description: The document's path in {profile_own}/documents, with / between folders, as config lists it; no segment starts with a dot. A prompt document names it as {profile_own}/documents/<path>.

content.description: The whole new text of the document; creates or replaces it.

delete.description: true deletes the document. Not with content.

if_match.description: The document's revision config listed; required to replace or delete it, left out to create a new one.

documents.description: Your own documents this edit creates, replaces or deletes, in the same change as contents. Only with action edit.

id.description: The own model's ID, <category>/<name>, as config lists it under models; no shared model may have it. Your profile offers it as profile:<category>/<name> once its models list names it.

content.description: The whole own model file: based_on (a shared model with its scope, global:<id> or workspace:<id>) and set (only the tuning keys an own model may change; the endpoint, the credential and the billed model always come from the base). Creates or replaces it.

delete.description: true deletes the own model. Not with content.

if_match.description: The own model's revision config listed; required to replace or delete it, left out to create a new one.

models.description: Your own models this edit creates, replaces or deletes, in the same change as contents and documents; each must load with its base, and the model your runs use must still load. Only with action edit.

id.description: The own toolset's ID, <category>/<name>, as config lists it under toolsets; no shared toolset may have it. Your profile uses it as profile:<category>/<name> once its toolset list names it.

content.description: The whole own toolset file: based_on (a shared toolset with its scope, global:<id> or workspace:<id>), omit (native, extension and mcp: names of the base to leave out) and set (native and extension: per tool, only the tuning keys an own toolset may change; hooks, MCP connections, paths, commands, environments, endpoints and limits always come from the base). Creates or replaces it.

delete.description: true deletes the own toolset. Not with content.

if_match.description: The own toolset's revision config listed; required to replace or delete it, left out to create a new one.

toolsets.description: Your own toolsets this edit creates, replaces or deletes, in the same change as contents, documents and models; each must compose with its base and pass the toolset rules, and your profile must still load. Only with action edit.

if_match.description: The revision of your profile file that config (or the last edit) showed; needed also when only documents, own models or own toolsets change. Only with actions edit and revert.

history_id.description: The history entry whose kept file revert restores, as history lists it. Only with action revert.

filters.description: Only profiles whose name matches every filter, case-insensitive. A filter with * or ? is a wildcard pattern (dev*, *coder); any other is a substring. Only with action list.

limit.description: Most items in this response; capped by the configuration. Only with actions list and history.

cursor.description: Continue where the previous list response stopped; use the cursor it gave. Only with action list.
